answer: An attester must stake 12% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the mesa stake is held until the plume settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the marble audit lists each exposure. A farm running 170 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
